description: Schedule a draft blog post for future publishing. Provide a datetime via scheduledFor; the platform publishes the post automatically at that time (checked every 5 minutes). Unschedule by patching status back to "draft"; publish immediately with post_posts_by_id_publish. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Pass true to confirm this action once the user has approved it.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

id.description: UUID of the draft post to schedule.

scheduledFor.description: When to publish, ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. 2026-11-12T14:00:00-05:00). One of scheduledFor, scheduled_for or schedule_at is required.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

name: post_posts_by_id_schedule
title: Post Posts by ID Schedule
